title: Man charged with Dersingham GP Dr Hannah Terry's murder
description: A man is charged with the murder of a GP who was found dead at her home.
content:
A man has been charged with the murder of a GP who was found dead at her home.
The man was arrested after the body of 45-year-old Dr Hannah Terry, also known as Hannah Cain, was found at a property in Fern Hill, Dersingham, Norfolk, on Sunday.

title: Roll-out begins for passport-free UK airport e-gates
description: The system uses facial technology to check travellers against immigration and passport information.
content:
